kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعجرف (form IIq)
# نَتَعَجْرَفُ (nataʕajrafu) /na.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# نُتَعَجْرَفُ (nutaʕajrafu) /nu.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# نَتَعَجْرَفَ (nataʕajrafa) /na.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# نُتَعَجْر
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
